reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
오마마마~너~~~무 귀요미^^
출시전부터 눈여겨보고있었던터라 출시되자마자 구매~
1인1장 구매여서 아쉬워하며 블루로 선택했는데 역시 귀여워요~
사이즈도 3키로 만쥬한테 딱이고 토마토너무귀여워요^^
니트원단도 좋고 색감도이쁘고~
옐로우도 주문했는데 기대됩니다~
reviews.content_en: Oh my gosh, SO cute~~ 😍 I've been keeping my eye on this since before the launch, so I bought it right away! I could only get one per person, so I went with blue and it's just as adorable as I hoped~ The size is perfect for my 3kg Manju, and Tomato is so cute too~~ The knit fabric is great and the color is beautiful~ I also ordered the yellow one and I'm so excited for it~

reviews.name: 엄****
reviews.content: 시츄 5.8킬로 몸통 40인데 라지를 샀어야 했는데 실수로 엑스라지를 시켰네요.다행이 넉넉하지만 안에 올인원 입히면 딱 좋을듯 싶어 구매확정 합니다.ssfw옷 넘 이뻐요.
reviews.content_en: I have a Shih Tzu that weighs 5.8kg with a 40cm chest, and I should've gotten Large but I accidentally ordered X-Large 😅 Luckily it's roomy enough, and I think it'll fit perfectly once I put an all-in-one underneath. Purchase confirmed! The SSFW outfit is so pretty.

reviews.name: 주****
reviews.content: 평소 라지사이즈 입는데 니트 빕도 라지 딱 맞아요. 크롭느낌으로 귀엽네요^^
reviews.content_en: I usually wear Large size and the knit bib fits perfectly in Large too. It has such a cute cropped vibe~~ ^^

reviews.name: 임****
reviews.content: 일단 너무 예쁩니다 레이어드 해서도입 힐 수 있고 두루두루 활용하기 좋은 거 같아요
reviews.content_en: It's just so pretty! You can layer it and wear it different ways too. It seems really versatile and practical ☺️

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
넘귀욥고 실물로보니 더 고급스러워요
사람옷보다 더이쁜거같아용☺️
reviews.content_en: It's super cute and even more luxurious in person! It's even prettier than human clothes 😄
